blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 BET 取樣策略的科學基礎 — 為什麼「頭、中、尾三瓶」可能不夠？
blocks.en: Understand the scientific basis of BET sampling strategy: why might the "beginning, middle, end" three-vial approach not be enough?

blocks.zh: 掌握合併樣品（Pooling）的優缺點與調整 MVD 的計算方法
blocks.en: Master the advantages and disadvantages of pooling samples and how to calculate the adjusted MVD

blocks.zh: 學會從 EU/mL 轉換為 EU/mg 的內毒素含量計算
blocks.en: Learn to convert EU/mL to EU/mg when calculating endotoxin content

blocks.zh: 認識標準曲線控管的重要性 — 斜率、截距和 onset time 的監控
blocks.en: Recognize the importance of standard curve control: monitoring slope, intercept and onset time

blocks.zh: Sampling — 取樣策略
blocks.en: Sampling

blocks.zh: 導師解析
blocks.en: Trainer's Analysis

blocks.zh: 核心概念：取樣的代表性問題
blocks.en: Core Concept: Representativeness of Sampling

blocks.zh: USP 在這裡挑戰了一個根深蒂固的行業習慣 —「頭、中、尾三瓶取樣」。這個方法有兩個根本假設：
blocks.en: USP challenges a deeply rooted industry habit here: "beginning, middle, end" three-vial sampling. This approach rests on two fundamental assumptions:

blocks.zh: 假設 1：內毒素在批次中均勻分布 — 錯誤！內毒素在液體和粉末中通常不均勻分布
blocks.en: Assumption 1: Endotoxin is uniformly distributed across the batch - wrong! Endotoxin is usually not uniformly distributed in liquids and powders

blocks.zh: 假設 2：三瓶足以代表整批 — 可能不夠！只有高度且均勻污染的批次才會被三瓶取樣抓到
blocks.en: Assumption 2: Three vials are enough to represent the whole batch - possibly not! Three-vial sampling will only catch batches that are highly and uniformly contaminated

blocks.zh: 正確的做法是基於製程知識和風險評估來設計取樣計劃。
blocks.en: The correct approach is to design the sampling plan based on process knowledge and risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 果園裡的蟲害檢查：
blocks.en: Pest inspection in an orchard:

blocks.zh: 想像你要檢查一大片果園是否有蟲害。如果你只看最前面、中間、最後面的三棵樹，你可能會漏掉一排特別靠近水溝（= 污染源）的樹。更好的做法是根據果園的地形、水源分布、過去蟲害的歷史來設計巡檢路線。
blocks.en: Imagine you need to check a large orchard for pests. If you only look at the first, middle and last trees, you may miss a row of trees right next to a drainage ditch (= the contamination source). A better approach is to design the inspection route according to the terrain, the water sources and the history of past infestations.

blocks.zh: 同樣地，充填線上某一根充填針頭如果清潔不當，可能只有那幾瓶藥品被污染。三瓶取樣很可能剛好沒取到那些瓶子。
blocks.en: Likewise, if one filling needle on a filling line is not cleaned properly, only the vials it filled may be contaminated. Three-vial sampling may well miss exactly those vials.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：水系統取樣的關鍵細節
blocks.en: Key Point: Critical Details of Water System Sampling

blocks.zh: 「用生產時的方式取樣」 — 這是一個經常被忽略但極其重要的原則。如果生產時是透過軟管從循環水迴路的某個取樣口取水，那你的 BET 樣品也必須用同一條軟管、同樣的沖洗時間。
blocks.en: "Sample the way you produce" - this principle is often overlooked but extremely important. If, in production, water is drawn from a sampling point on the recirculating loop through a hose, then your BET sample must be drawn with the same hose and the same flushing time.

blocks.zh: 為什麼？因為取樣口本身可能是內毒素的來源。如果你用不同的設備或不同的沖洗方式取樣，得到的結果可能無法代表生產時的實際狀況。
blocks.en: Why? Because the sampling point itself may be a source of endotoxin. If you sample with different equipment or a different flushing method, the result may not represent the actual condition during production.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Exercises for Reflection

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠充填一批小量注射劑（10,000 瓶），使用 8 根充填針頭。你會如何設計 BET 取樣計劃？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your CDMO site fills a small batch of injectable product (10,000 vials) using 8 filling needles. How would you design the BET sampling plan, and why?

blocks.zh: 一個關鍵原料供應商提供的 CoA 顯示內毒素結果為 <0.5 EU/mL。你是新任 QC 經理，應該如何建立供應商管控機制？
blocks.en: The CoA from a key raw material supplier shows an endotoxin result of <0.5 EU/mL. As the new QC manager, how should you establish a supplier control mechanism?

blocks.zh: Pooling — 合併樣品策略
blocks.en: Pooling

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Pooling 的數學代價
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Mathematical Cost of Pooling

blocks.zh: Pooling 看似省錢省時，但有一個隱藏的數學代價：
blocks.en: Pooling appears to save money and time, but it carries a hidden mathematical cost:

blocks.zh: 假設三瓶中只有一瓶被污染（5 EU/mL），其餘兩瓶乾淨（<0.05 EU/mL）。合併後的污染濃度變成約 1.7 EU/mL — 可能從「超標」變成「合格」。
blocks.en: Suppose only one of three vials is contaminated (5 EU/mL) and the other two are clean (<0.05 EU/mL). After pooling, the contamination concentration becomes about 1.7 EU/mL - a result that could change from "out of specification" to "passing".

blocks.zh: 為了補償這個稀釋效應，MVD 必須除以合併瓶數。這相當於把內毒素限值變得更嚴格，因為你的檢測「起點」更稀了。
blocks.en: To compensate for this dilution effect, the MVD must be divided by the number of vials pooled. This effectively makes the endotoxin limit stricter, because your test "starting point" is more dilute.

blocks.zh: 混合果汁的品質檢測：
blocks.en: Quality testing of mixed juice:

blocks.zh: 想像你有三瓶果汁，其中一瓶可能壞了。如果你把三瓶混在一起嘗味道，壞味道被稀釋了，你可能嘗不出來。所以你的「品嘗標準」（= MVD）必須變得更敏感（除以 3），才能在混合液中偵測到那一瓶的問題。
blocks.en: Imagine you have three bottles of juice and one of them may have gone bad. If you mix all three and taste the blend, the bad taste is diluted and you may not detect it. So your "tasting standard" (= MVD) has to become more sensitive (divided by 3) to detect the problem bottle in the mixture.

blocks.zh: 更好的做法可能是直接分別嘗每一瓶 — 雖然比較費時，但能精確找出問題源。
blocks.en: A better approach may be to taste each bottle separately. It takes more time, but it pinpoints the source of the problem precisely.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的 Pooling 決策
blocks.en: Key Point: Pooling Decisions at a CDMO

blocks.zh: MVD 已經很低的產品不適合 pooling：如果 MVD 只有 20，pooling 3 瓶後變成 ~7，可能連消除干擾的空間都不夠
blocks.en: Products with an already low MVD are not suitable for pooling: if the MVD is only 20, pooling 3 vials reduces it to ~7, which may leave no room even to overcome interference

blocks.zh: 保留原始容器：pooling 後如果 OOS，你需要回去測個別瓶子。如果已經丟了，調查就陷入死胡同
blocks.en: Retain the original containers: if a pooled sample gives an OOS result, you need to go back and test the individual vials. If they have been discarded, the investigation reaches a dead end

blocks.zh: 製程中間體不要 pool：不同製程階段的樣品代表不同的製程狀態，合併會失去追溯價值
blocks.en: Do not pool in-process intermediates: samples from different process stages represent different process states, and pooling them loses traceability

blocks.zh: 醫療器材例外：器材的 pooling 不需要調整 MVD，因為限值已經是「per device」而非「per mL」
blocks.en: Medical device exception: pooling of devices does not require MVD adjustment, because the limit is already expressed "per device" rather than "per mL"

blocks.zh: 你的產品 MVD = 50。如果 pooling 5 瓶，adjusted MVD 變成 10。在 1:10 稀釋處仍有干擾。你會怎麼處理？
blocks.en: Your product has an MVD of 50. If you pool 5 vials, the adjusted MVD becomes 10. Interference is still present at the 1:10 dilution. How would you handle it?

blocks.zh: 什麼情況下 pooling 是合理的選擇？什麼情況下你會強烈建議個別測試？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances is pooling a reasonable choice? When would you strongly recommend testing individual units?

blocks.zh: Calculation of Endotoxin Content — 內毒素含量計算
blocks.en: Calculation of Endotoxin Content

blocks.zh: 核心概念：單位轉換
blocks.en: Core Concept: Unit Conversion

blocks.zh: BET 儀器直接輸出的結果永遠是 EU/mL。但產品限值可能以不同單位表示：
blocks.en: The result a BET instrument reports is always in EU/mL. But the product limit may be expressed in different units:

blocks.zh: EU/mL — 直接比較，無需轉換
blocks.en: EU/mL - compare directly, no conversion needed

blocks.zh: EU/mg — 需要除以產品濃度（mg/mL）
blocks.en: EU/mg - divide by the product concentration (mg/mL)

blocks.zh: EU/unit — 需要除以產品效價（units/mL）
blocks.en: EU/unit - divide by the product potency (units/mL)

blocks.zh: EU/device — 需要乘以萃取體積
blocks.en: EU/device - multiply by the extraction volume

blocks.zh: 轉換時別忘了先把稀釋倍數算回去！
blocks.en: Do not forget to factor the dilution back in before converting!

blocks.zh: 重點提示：稀釋倍數的陷阱
blocks.en: Key Point: The Dilution Factor Trap

blocks.zh: 如果你的樣品做了 1:100 稀釋，儀器讀到 0.05 EU/mL，那實際的內毒素含量是 0.05 × 100 = 5 EU/mL。許多 BET 軟體會自動帶入稀釋因子，但分析師必須確認軟體設定正確。
blocks.en: If your sample was diluted 1:100 and the instrument reads 0.05 EU/mL, the actual endotoxin content is 0.05 × 100 = 5 EU/mL. Many BET software packages enter the dilution factor automatically, but the analyst must confirm that the software settings are correct.

blocks.zh: 產品濃度 25 mg/mL，限值 2 EU/mg，凝膠法在 1:50 稀釋處（最後陽性管）檢出。實際結果是多少 EU/mg？是否合格？
blocks.en: The product concentration is 25 mg/mL, the limit is 2 EU/mg, and the gel-clot method gives an endpoint (last positive tube) at the 1:50 dilution. What is the actual result in EU/mg? Does it pass?

blocks.zh: Standard Curve Control — 標準曲線管控
blocks.en: Standard Curve Control

blocks.zh: 核心概念：|r| 不是萬靈丹
blocks.en: Core Concept: |r| Is Not a Cure-All

blocks.zh: 這是 ⟨1085⟩ 中最有啟發性的警告之一：相關係數合格不代表標準曲線正確！
blocks.en: This is one of the most instructive warnings in ⟨1085⟩: a passing correlation coefficient does not mean the standard curve is correct!

blocks.zh: 為什麼？因為 r 值只衡量「線性關係的強度」，不衡量「位置是否正確」。你可以把所有標準品都稀釋錯兩倍，曲線照樣是一條漂亮的直線（r ≥ 0.980），但曲線整體偏移了。
blocks.en: Why? Because r only measures "the strength of the linear relationship", not "whether the position is correct". You could dilute all the standards wrongly by a factor of two and the curve would still be a beautiful straight line (r ≥ 0.980), yet the whole curve would be shifted.

blocks.zh: 過度稀釋 → onset time 偏長 → 曲線向上偏移 → 樣品結果被高估
blocks.en: Over-dilution → onset time too long → curve shifts upward → sample results overestimated

blocks.zh: 稀釋不足 → onset time 偏短 → 曲線向下偏移 → 樣品結果被低估
blocks.en: Under-dilution → onset time too short → curve shifts downward → sample results underestimated

blocks.zh: 地圖的比例尺錯了：
blocks.en: A map with the wrong scale:

blocks.zh: 想像你有一張地圖，所有道路的相對位置都對（= r 值很高），但比例尺標錯了（= 標準品濃度不對）。你量兩點之間的距離會得到一個看似合理的數字，但實際距離完全不對。
blocks.en: Imagine a map on which the relative positions of all the roads are correct (= a high r value) but the scale is labeled wrongly (= the standard concentrations are wrong). You measure the distance between two points and get a plausible-looking number, but the real distance is completely off.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 USP 建議監控 onset time 和 y-intercept，而不只看 r 值。onset time 就是地圖上的「地標」— 它們應該在每次使用同一批試劑時保持一致。
blocks.en: This is why USP recommends monitoring onset time and y-intercept, not just the r value. Onset times are the "landmarks" on the map: they should remain consistent every time the same reagent lots are used.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：CDMO 的標準曲線監控
blocks.en: Key Point: Standard Curve Monitoring at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 建立 onset time 資料庫：針對每個 lysate lot × CSE lot 組合，記錄每次運行的各濃度標準品 onset time
blocks.en: Build an onset time database: for each lysate lot × CSE lot combination, record the onset times of the standards at each concentration in every run

blocks.zh: 設定趨勢警戒值：當 onset time 或 y-intercept 超出歷史範圍時發出警報，即使 r 值仍然合格
blocks.en: Set trend alert limits: raise an alert when onset time or y-intercept falls outside the historical range, even if the r value still passes

blocks.zh: 跨分析師比較：不同分析師使用同一批試劑，onset time 應該一致。如果某分析師的 onset time 系統性偏長或偏短，可能是技術問題
blocks.en: Compare across analysts: different analysts using the same reagent lots should obtain consistent onset times. If one analyst's onset times are systematically longer or shorter, it may be a technique issue

blocks.zh: 0.980 不能四捨五入：0.979 不合格，這一點在審計時經常被查
blocks.en: 0.980 cannot be rounded up: 0.979 fails, and this point is frequently cited in audits

blocks.zh: 你的分析師報告標準曲線 r = 0.998，看起來很好。但你注意到本次的 y-intercept 比過去 20 次的平均值高了 15%。這可能代表什麼問題？你會怎麼調查？
blocks.en: Your analyst reports a standard curve with r = 0.998, which looks good. But you notice that this run's y-intercept is 15% higher than the average of the last 20 runs. What might this indicate? How would you investigate?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 log<sub>10</sub> 轉換後的 kinetic 標準曲線對小變化特別敏感？
blocks.en: Why is a log<sub>10</sub>-transformed kinetic standard curve particularly sensitive to small changes?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 取樣策略：「頭中尾三瓶」可能不夠 — 需要基於製程知識和風險評估來設計取樣計劃
blocks.en: Sampling strategy: "beginning, middle, end" three vials may not be enough - design the sampling plan based on process knowledge and risk assessment

blocks.zh: 取樣設備：必須用與生產相同的設備和沖洗程序取樣，特別是水系統
blocks.en: Sampling equipment: sample with the same equipment and flushing procedure used in production, especially for water systems

blocks.zh: Pooling 代價：Adjusted MVD = Original MVD / 合併瓶數。合併可能掩蓋單瓶污染，降低調查價值
blocks.en: Cost of pooling: Adjusted MVD = Original MVD / number of vials pooled. Pooling can mask contamination in a single vial and reduces the value of an investigation

blocks.zh: 單位轉換：BET 輸出 EU/mL，需要根據限值單位（EU/mg、EU/device）做適當轉換
blocks.en: Unit conversion: BET outputs EU/mL; convert appropriately according to the unit of the limit (EU/mg, EU/device)

blocks.zh: 標準曲線管控：|r| ≥ 0.980 是必要條件但不充分 — 必須同時監控 onset time、slope、y-intercept
blocks.en: Standard curve control: |r| ≥ 0.980 is necessary but not sufficient - onset time, slope and y-intercept must be monitored as well

blocks.zh: 稀釋錯誤的偽裝：標準品稀釋錯誤可能產生合格的 r 值，但導致所有結果系統性偏差
blocks.en: Dilution errors in disguise: an incorrectly diluted standard can still give a passing r value yet cause systematic bias in all results
